title: 玩家操作缺乏实际影响与反馈
description: 玩家的操作对游戏进程或结果没有实际影响，互动缺乏视觉或行为反馈，导致玩家感到操作无意义。
evidence: the player's actions had an effect on the outcome
It would be really convenient if you could just call the girl to find out if she's still coming.
You can interact with things, sure but only when the game tells you that it's okay to, otherwise you just hover your hand over it

evidence_items.quote: It would be really convenient if you could just call the girl to find out if she's still coming.
evidence_items.description: 无法通过打电话等方式确认约会对象是否还会来
evidence_items.quote_zh: 要是能直接给那女孩打个电话，看看她到底还来不来，那就真的方便多了。

evidence_items.quote: You can interact with things, sure but only when the game tells you that it's okay to, otherwise you just hover your hand over it
evidence_items.description: 只能按游戏允许的时机互动，否则手悬停无效果
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可以和东西互动，当然，但只有在游戏告诉你现在可以的时候，否则你就只是把手悬停在上面

evidence_items.quote: Puedes intentar tomarte un litro de vino sin que algo cambie (y de hecho, la botella ni siquiera cambia).
evidence_items.description: 喝酒后瓶子模型不发生变化，行为没有视觉反馈
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可以试着喝下一升葡萄酒，而什么都不会改变（事实上，连瓶子都不会变）。

evidence_items.quote: the player's actions had an effect on the outcome
evidence_items.description: 玩家操作对结局没有影响，互动性极低
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家的行为对结果产生了影响
